Maya Chen: Quick check — we're starting p10b int4 bring-up this morning. Need a plan for promptset dedupe and a fresh golden refresh. Can the curation crew take lead?
Leo Park: I can own dedupe. thinking to run semantic + fingerprint two-pass. will do a small sample first.
Anika Patel: I'll sync labeler capacity. estimate ~3k items/day if we do microbatches. Any constraints on label schema?
Maya Chen: Keep current gold schema but add a `model_ref` field in labels for the first 2 waves so we can trace regressions.
Samir Rao: For quant smoke, we should benchmark LR+F1 on the existing goldset then on the deduped set. I'll set up the eval harness.
curie-bot: Deploy started: qbench/p10b-int4 -> staging (job id q-2026-88). Logs at https://ci.internal/qbench/2026-88
Leo Park: Plan for dedupe: 1) fast fingerprint to remove exact dup 2) SBERT cluster for near-dup 3) keep one per cluster by highest token-length + earlier source priority. will push script.
Anika Patel: Labeler note: if we change sample order, we need to preserve microgoldens interleaved ~5% to detect drift. Also need updated instructions for p10b artifacts.
Raj Singh: For golden refresh: propose a stratified refresh (by intent, length, multimodal flag). We should avoid reusing >30% of previous golden to exercise model differences.
Maya Chen: Agree on stratified approach. Also add adversarial edgecases from the quant smoke (Samir) as a mini-golden subset.
Samir Rao: Starting eval runs now. Quick heads-up: we saw weird tokenization mismatch with the int4 runtime for code-like prompts — will log examples.
Leo Park: ETA for dedupe sample script: EOD today for a 10k preview. Will attach results and a small `dupe_report.csv`.
Anika Patel: Scheduling labeler batch slots: can take 6k over next 3 days. Will flag any ambiguous items for triage channel.
Maya Chen: Great. Next sync: tomorrow 10am PT to review dedupe report, eval baselines, and golden candidate list. @curie-bot please post the qbench results here when done. :thumbsup:
